# WorkClips

`world-system`

Which rig clip each kind of work plays (loop for a hold, once for a single action), and the fraction of the clip at which the strike lands.

> Make work visible: every kind of work has its own motion, and other players see it (Phase 281)

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| fallbackClip | string | Clip a rig without the work clip plays |
| rigClips | json | Clip names the player rig contract carries for work |
| clips | json | { <work kind>: { clip, mode: loop\|once, impact } } |
